def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative threshold")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    if raw_weights.sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon must be at least 1")
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_no = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_with = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no, L_call)
    margins = L_minus - L_with

    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
